brief.goal: Discover current Qiankun media_id candidates from historical real monitors intersected with current mediaList, then readonly-validate account/API/agent relations for at most three candidates.

rationality_assessment.reason: The prior readonly run recovered account identity and isolated the blocker to the stale historical media_id 310. Intersecting real historical monitor rows with the current media list is a controlled way to discover current candidates.
rationality_assessment.caveat: changeMediaId and changeMediaAccountId are treated only as readonly dependent-select probes in this task; monitor creation and token refresh remain forbidden.

permissions.sensitive_data_rule: Never print, persist, or expose token, Cookie, raw request, raw response, complete touchpoint URLs, or other secrets.
